{{Top|leg}}
The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] granted the heavily-modified [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] a '''Class-one Waiver''' dispensation in [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]]. This allowed [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to continue to command [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Light freighter/Legends|vessel]], even though the ship violated every specification and performance regulation in the book.<ref name="FF 4">{{FactFile|4|MIL 1-2|''Millennium Falcon''}}</ref>
